ModMetaData.name: Combat Extended - Infinite Ammo (Continued)
ModMetaData.author: daz96050
ModMetaData.description:
Infinite ammo!
This mod adds different variants of infinite ammo to more match the base game. This is for those who wants to still play around with ammo types but do not want to worry much about ammo logistics. This does make the game significantly easier, but can be fun.
Features: - Infinite Ammo (No Reloading) - Infinite Reserve (With Reloading), including bows and other weapons without a magazine - Optional: no ammo needed at all, just pick the ammo type from the reload button - Infinite Turret Ammo - Infinite Mortar Ammo - Infinite Grenades - Player Faction Only option - Optional rebalance, applied only to ammo that something gets infinite ammo for: - Ammo recipes make 1 round at a multiplied cost - Limit ammo stacks to 1 - Generated pawns, traders, quest rewards and loot carry or offer only a few single rounds
Supports RimWorld 1.6 and 1.7.
Load this mod AFTER Combat Extended.
Requires Combat Extended to function.
